constant_mean_baseline.note: Model MAE is comparable to the constant-mean baseline; the evidence for input-dependence is the ICC permutation test below.

test1_intersession_icc.statistic: ICC(3,1) between per-subject HFC and HFE predictions
test1_intersession_icc.interpretation: Per-subject predictions agree across two independent sessions far beyond chance => input-dependent, not a constant/mean predictor.

test2_anatomical_tracking.statistic: Pearson r between predicted and true nWBV
test2_anatomical_tracking.interpretation: The reproducible signal does NOT track true nWBV; reported transparently, consistent with the feasibility-baseline framing.
